enableDefaultFlair.label: Use default 'Mod Team 🛡️' user flair?
enableDefaultFlair.helpText: Disable to allow Relay App to use whatever custom user flair you manually assign it in your subreddit tools.

notification-settings.label: Notifications
notification-settings.helpText: Configure notifications for various Relay App activities.

enable_update_notifications.label: Upgrade Notifications
enable_update_notifications.helpText: Enable to receive a modmail when a new version of Relay App is available.

notify_on_posts.label: Post Reply Notifications
notify_on_posts.helpText: Enable to receive Modmail notifications when users reply to posts or comments made via Relay App.

notify_on_comments.label: Comment Reply Notifications
notify_on_comments.helpText: Enable to receive Modmail notifications when users reply to comments made via Relay App.

notify_on_mod_replies.label: Moderator Reply Notifications
notify_on_mod_replies.helpText: Enable to receive Modmail notifications when moderators reply to posts/comments made via Relay App.

notify_extra_users.label: Additional User Reply Notifications
notify_extra_users.helpText: Optionally specify additional usernames to monitor for replies (e.g., AutoModerator). Add usernames as a comma-separated list without u/. Usernames are not case-sensitive.

sendModmail.label: Send Relay App Notifications to Modmail?
sendModmail.helpText: Enable to receive a copy of each Relay App publish and edit in Modmail.

sendDiscord.label: Send Relay App Notifications to Discord?
sendDiscord.helpText: Enable to receive notifications of each Relay App publish and edit in your Discord server via webhook. Very long posts may be truncated by Discord.

webhookEditor.label: Discord Webhook URL
webhookEditor.helpText: Paste your Discord webhook URL (Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks).

discordRole.label: Discord Role ID to Ping
discordRole.helpText: Optionally add a Discord role ID to @mention (enable mention permissions for that role in Discord).

auto-flair-settings.label: Auto-Flair
auto-flair-settings.helpText: Configure how Relay App handles flairs in your community.

setFlairAfterPosting.label: Auto-Flair Posts
setFlairAfterPosting.helpText: Enable to automatically update the post flair after a Relay App post is published.

relayAppPostFlairText.label: Post Flair to Use
relayAppPostFlairText.helpText: Enter the post flair to apply after a Relay App post is published.

setFlairAfterCommenting.label: Auto-Flair Comments
setFlairAfterCommenting.helpText: Enable to automatically update the post flair after a Relay App comment is published.

relayAppCommentPostFlairText.label: Post Flair to Use
relayAppCommentPostFlairText.helpText: Enter the post flair to apply after a Relay App comment is published.

template-1-settings.label: Template 1 Settings
template-1-settings.helpText: Configure settings and scheduling for Template 1

postTemplate1name.label: Template 1 Name
postTemplate1name.helpText: Internal name shown only in settings. Not visible to users or in posts.

postTemplate1title.label: Template 1 Post Title
postTemplate1title.helpText: Post title for Template 1. Note: Post titles can only be edited prior to publishing.

postTemplate1body.label: Template 1 Post Body
postTemplate1body.helpText: Body text for Template 1 (markdown supported). Body text can be edited before and after publishing.

postTemplate1Enabled.label: Template 1 Scheduling
postTemplate1Enabled.helpText: Enable to schedule recurring posts using Template 1.

postTemplate1Daily.label: Repeat Daily?
postTemplate1Daily.helpText: Enable to schedule post every day. If OFF, this will only post once at the next scheduled time.

postTemplate1Weekly.label: Repeat Weekly?
postTemplate1Weekly.helpText: Enable to schedule post weekly. If OFF, this will only post once at the next scheduled time.

postTemplate1Monthly.label: Repeat Monthly?
postTemplate1Monthly.helpText: Enable to schedule post monthly. If OFF, this will only post once at the next scheduled time.

postTemplate1MonthDay.label: Day of month (1-31)
postTemplate1MonthDay.helpText: Day of the month the post should be published. If the month has fewer days than set value, the post will be published on the last day of the month.

postTemplate1Hour.label: Hour (0-23) UTC
postTemplate1Hour.helpText: Use 24-hour format (e.g., 13 = 1 PM, 17 = 5 PM). All schedules follow UTC time.

postTemplate1Minute.label: Minute (0-59) UTC
postTemplate1Minute.helpText: Minute of the hour (0-59). All schedules follow UTC time.

postTemplate1Sticky.label: Scheduled Post Auto-Sticky
postTemplate1Sticky.helpText: Enable to sticky the scheduled post on publish.

postTemplate1Lock.label: Scheduled Post Auto-Lock
postTemplate1Lock.helpText: Enable to lock the scheduled post on publish.

postTemplate1AutoUnsticky.label: Previous Post Auto-Unsticky
postTemplate1AutoUnsticky.helpText: Enable to unsticky previously published post when a new post from this template is published.

postTemplate1AutoLock.label: Previous Post Auto-Lock
postTemplate1AutoLock.helpText: Enable to lock previously published post when a new post from this template is published.
